label: TX Site - Universal
info: Universal flow for one transmitter location: SNMP polling, ping health, Modbus status, InfluxDB write.

name: Site Config
info: Edit values in the 'Init Site Config' function: site_id, site_name, location, IPs, SNMP community, OIDs, Modbus URL.

name: Init Site Config
SNMP FAST (5s): deviation, reflection, alarm
info: Every 5s, poll reflection/deviation/alarms and write to Influx measurement tx_telemetry_fast.

name: Build SNMP fast cmd
Parse SNMP fast -> Influx
SNMP SLOW (30s): temperature, power, frequency
info: Every 30s, poll temperature/power/frequency and write to Influx measurement tx_telemetry_slow.

name: Build SNMP slow cmd
Parse SNMP slow -> Influx
Ping health (5s): gateway, pc, transmitter, modbus
info: Every 5s, ping all critical hosts and write reachability + RTT to Influx.

name: Build ping targets
Parse ping -> Influx
Modbus relay status (5s) via HTTP bridge
info: Uses /?data=<HEX> endpoint and parses 8 relay bits from response byte #4 (index 3).

name: Build Modbus status URL
Parse Modbus bits -> Influx
Relay command/ack: queue, verify, retry, Influx
info: POST /tx/relay/set with JSON {channel:1..8,state:0|1,source}. Includes test inject node.

name: Normalize relay command
Build relay command HEX
Prepare verify
Build verify status URL
Evaluate ACK
Retry or fail
ACK success -> Influx
ACK fail -> Influx
